_comment: Spec §7. On ARMED the praise screen types one of these instantly, from local memory,
with no network call and nothing to await. It covers the 3-5 second generation gap so
two silent screens never read as broken, and it covers a skipped generation invisibly:
the greeting is already on screen while the fallback conversation loads.
Two words each, warm but never about how anyone looks — this fires before any frame has
been read, so it cannot know anything about the visitor and must not pretend to.
It is always the praise screen. The roast screen holds.
